snippet.title: Bobo Bay Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase: May 2025
snippet.description:
Bobo Bay is a pet simulation game where you collect, mash(breed), accessorize, and train little creatures to compete in races and other competitions.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1889810/Bobo_Bay/

Visit https://www.sixoneindie.com/showcase for more information.
